segments.text: The home directory holds a setuid helper called bandit twenty-seven do, owned by bandit twenty-seven.
I log in as bandit26 with ssh bandit26@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
Same break-out as the last level: showtext, more, v, vi, shell, to get a real shell.
I list the helper, and the permissions show the s bit, owned by bandit twenty-seven.
I run the helper with cat on bandit twenty-seven's password file.
It runs as bandit twenty-seven, and prints the password for bandit twenty-seven, and the level is solved.
